description: This file defines a generic internal class LogViewAdaptor for managing log views in an Orleans-based event sourcing system. It handles reading and writing log state asynchronously, merging notifications, and maintaining a confirmed view of the log. It also includes nested classes for error handling and notification messages.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>
classes.description: A generic internal class that adapts log views for Orleans event sourcing, managing log state, reading/writing to storage, and processing notifications.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>.UpdateLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Exception class indicating failure during log storage write operations.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>.ReadFromLogStorageFailed
classes.description: Exception class indicating failure during log storage read operations.

classes.name: LogViewAdaptor<TLogView, TLogEntry>.UpdateNotificationMessage
classes.description: Notification message class used to inform remote instances of log updates, including version, origin, updates, and ETag.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the last confirmed log view.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the last confirmed log.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Initializes the confirmed view with a given initial state.

methods.name: UpdateConfirmedView
methods.description: Updates the confirmed view by applying new log entries.

methods.name: RetrieveLogSegment
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of the log between specified versions asynchronously.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a submission entry for a given log entry.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the log state from storage, with retry logic.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the current log batch to storage, with retry and verification.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two notification messages if they are from the same origin and contiguous.

methods.name: OnNotificationReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming notification messages and adds them to the queue.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Processes queued notifications, updating the log state accordingly.

methods.name: enter_operation
methods.description: Debug helper to mark the start of an operation.

methods.name: exit_operation
methods.description: Debug helper to mark the end of an operation.
